title: Supported by is empty or an inactive user
cardHint: Supported by is empty, or names a person who is no longer active. The owner or manager names the person.
cardText: Supported by is important, but it comes after Owned by and Managed by. On a Service Instance the owner fills it in EPO (Secondary Responsible). On a Service Offering the owner or manager replies, or raises the request to modify the offering. Only these two classes are checked.

message.subject: Supported by to fill
message.intro: The role Supported by is empty, or names a person who is no longer active.
message.ask: Could you tell us who it should be? Please {reply}, and we will update ServiceNow for you.
message.why: The support person is the second contact for incidents on these CIs.

askByClass.service_offering: Could you tell us who it should be? You can {reply}, or raise the request {request:modify-service-offering}.
